written: 2026-10-19, before any intraday result was computed

rule_relative.C1: Bollinger BandWidth(20,2) percentile over the previous 126 bars > 0.80 (same as daily)
rule_relative.C2: stock z20 = (close/close[20]-1) / (std of 1-bar log returns over 126 bars * sqrt(20)) < -1.12
rule_relative.C3: SPY z5 = (close/close[5]-1) / (std 1-bar log ret 126 bars * sqrt(5)) < -1.25, SPY bar ending at the same time
rule_relative.thresholds: frequency-matched on DAILY data 2000-2026 to the absolute rule (-10% / -3%), see calib.json

bars: session-anchored resample of 5-min bars from 09:30; indicators run continuously across days (overnight gaps included)
entry: close of the signal bar; one open position per symbol per horizon

horizons.primary: 2 bars (fractal analogue of the daily 2-session hold)

control: the same relative rule on DAILY bars must reproduce the round-10 daily edge
pass_criteria: primary horizon: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 on ORIGINAL 15 (2016-2026), same sign in both halves (2016-2020, 2021-2026) and on NEW 30 (2023-2026); then mean must exceed a real-option cost hurdle; only passing frames get the real option replay
